title: Invoice self-service
body:
**Goal:** Enable residential customers to independently find, view, and download their recent invoices in the customer portal.

**Benefit:** Customers can obtain invoice copies without contacting support; support demand for invoice copies is expected to decrease.

**Success Measure:** Validate whether invoice-copy contacts decrease after release; the target and measurement baseline must be agreed with the product team before use.

**In Scope:** Invoice overview, invoice details, and PDF download for invoices that are already available in the billing system.

**Out of Scope:** Creating invoices, payment collection, dunning, changing billing addresses, and invoices not available from the billing system.

**Candidate Stories:**
- Download an existing invoice as PDF
- View the invoice overview
- See an empty-state message when no invoice is available

title: Download invoice as PDF
body:
**Story:** As a residential customer, I want to download an existing invoice as a PDF so that I can store it for my accounting.

**Context:** Self-Service Customer Portal, residential customers, part of Epic #1.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in and have at least one invoice, when I select "Download PDF", then the download starts within 3 seconds.
- [ ] Given I have no invoice, when I open the invoices page, then I see "No invoices available".
- [ ] Given the PDF is generated, when I open it, then it contains the invoice number, date, total amount, and my customer number.
- [ ] Given I am not signed in, when I access an invoice URL, then I am redirected to the sign-in page.

title: Reset password
body:
**Story:** As a customer, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access if I forget it.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am on the login page, when I click "Forgot password", then I receive an email with a reset link.
- [ ] Given I click the reset link, when I enter a new password, then I can log in with the new password.
- [ ] Given the link is older than 24 hours, when I click it, then I see an error message.

title: Manage account settings
body:
**Story:** As a customer, I want to manage my profile, notification preferences, payment method, and security settings so that my account is up to date.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in, when I open account settings, then I see all options.
- [ ] Given I change a setting, when I save, then the change is applied.

title: Modernize the portal
body: The customer portal should be modern and better.

title: View invoice overview
body:
**Story:** As a residential customer, I want to view a list of my available invoices so that I can see what I owe.

**Context:** Self-Service Customer Portal, residential customers, part of Epic #1.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in, when I open the invoices page, then I see a list of my invoices sorted by date descending.
- [ ] Given I have no invoices, when I open the page, then I see "No invoices available".
- [ ] Given I select an invoice, when I click it, then I see the invoice details.

title: Change payment method
body:
**Story:** As a customer, I want to change my payment method so that I can pay with a different card.

**Context:** Self-Service Customer Portal.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given I am signed in, when I open payment settings, then I see my current payment method.
- [ ] Given I add a new card, when I save, then the new card is used for future invoices.
- [ ] Given the card is invalid, when I try to save, then I see an error message.

title: Database migration to PostgreSQL 16
body:
**Task:** Migrate the database from PostgreSQL 15 to PostgreSQL 16.

**Result:** Database runs on PostgreSQL 16 with all data intact.

**Done when:**
- [ ] Backup is created
- [ ] Migration is tested in staging
- [ ] Production migration is completed

title: PDF download fails on mobile Safari
body:
**Bug:** PDF download fails on mobile Safari.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Open the invoices page on mobile Safari
2. Click "Download PDF"

**Expected:** Download starts
**Actual:** Error message appears

**Environment:** iOS 17, Safari
